name: com.shipstatic/mcp
title: ShipStatic
description: Deploy static websites, landing pages, and prototypes instantly. Free, no account needed.

tools.name: deployments_upload
tools.description:
Deploy a static site to a live URL: free, no account or API key required.

**File content is plain text by default.** Pass HTML/CSS/JS/JSON/SVG/etc. directly in each file's `content` as a regular string. Only set `encoding: "base64"` per-file for binary content (images, fonts). Do not base64-encode text.

Returns the live URL. Without a connected account, the response also includes a one-time claim URL, and the site expires in 3 days unless claimed. Pass `password` to make the site private.

path.description: Relative path within the site (e.g. "index.html", "assets/app.css"). No leading slash; no parent-folder wrapping.

content.description: File content as a plain text string. For HTML, CSS, JS, JSON, SVG and plain text, pass it directly with no encoding step. For binary files (images, fonts) ONLY, set this entry's `encoding: "base64"` and pass base64-encoded bytes.

encoding.description: Defaults to `"utf-8"` (raw text). Set to `"base64"` ONLY for binary files. Never base64-encode text content: pass it as a plain string.

files.description: Files that make up the site. The site root is implied by these paths.

labels.description: Labels for organizing deployments (e.g. ["env:production", "v1.2"]). Each is a word, or a key and a value split by one ":". Lowercase, 3 to 63 characters, allows . _ - inside a word. Up to 10.

password.description: Optional password to gate the deployment behind an unlock prompt (6 to 128 characters; spaces at the start and end are trimmed). Visitors must enter this password before viewing the site, including on any custom domains pointing at it.

idempotencyKey.description: Makes this deploy replayable instead of repeatable. A deploy is not naturally idempotent: if a call times out you cannot tell "it never landed" from "it landed and the response was lost", and retrying creates a second deployment. Send the same key on the retry and you get back the deployment the first try made, if it went live in the last 24 hours. A key works only within the account that sent it: without an account it is ignored, and a retry deploys again. Key the ATTEMPT (a run id, a commit sha, a uuid minted before the first try), never one minted fresh on each retry, which would defeat the point.

ttl.description: Seconds until this deployment expires and the platform reclaims it; omit for one that never does. Only for authenticated deploys: an anonymous deployment already expires on the platform's schedule, and a requested ttl on one is refused. A deployment carrying a ttl cannot be linked to any domain: deploy without one if the site needs a domain.

tools.name: deployments_list
tools.description: List all deployments with their URLs, status, labels, and password protection state. The response's `cursor` is null on the last page; pass it back as `cursor` to fetch the next.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return in one page. Omit for the server default.

cursor.description: Opaque position from the previous response's `cursor` field; omit for the first page.

tools.name: deployments_get
tools.description: Get deployment details including URL, status, file count, size, labels, and password protection state.

deployment.description: Deployment hostname (e.g. "happy-cat-abc1234.shipstatic.com"). Returned by deployments_upload or deployments_list.

tools.name: deployments_set
tools.description: Update deployment labels. Replaces all existing labels.

deployment.description: Deployment hostname (e.g. "happy-cat-abc1234.shipstatic.com"). Use deployments_list to find deployments.

labels.description: Labels to set. Replaces all existing labels. Pass empty array to clear.

tools.name: deployments_delete
tools.description: Permanently deletes a deployment and its files.

tools.name: domains_set
tools.description: Create or update a domain: a ShipStatic domain (e.g. "yourname.shipstatic.com"), live as soon as a deployment is linked, or a custom domain (e.g. "www.example.com"), which needs DNS records first. Can reserve a name (omit deployment), link it to a deployment, switch deployments, or update labels. For a custom domain, domains_records then returns the DNS records to configure.

domain.description: Domain name: a ShipStatic domain (e.g. "yourname.shipstatic.com") or a custom domain (e.g. "www.example.com")

deployment.description: Deployment to serve on this domain (e.g. "happy-cat-abc1234.shipstatic.com"). Omit to reserve the domain without linking.

tools.name: domains_list
tools.description: List all domains with their URLs, linked deployment, and `status`. The response's `cursor` is null on the last page; pass it back as `cursor` to fetch the next.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return in one page. Omit for the server default.

cursor.description: Opaque position from the previous response's `cursor` field; omit for the first page.

tools.name: domains_get
tools.description: Get domain details including URL, linked deployment, labels, and `status`: the one word saying what the domain needs from its owner (`unverified`, `unlinked`, `live`, `paused`).

domain.description: Domain name (e.g. "www.example.com"). Use domains_list to find names.

tools.name: domains_records
tools.description: Returns the DNS records to configure at the domain's DNS provider. Call after domains_set. Custom domains only: a ShipStatic domain has no records to configure.

domain.description: Domain name. Must be a domain previously created with domains_set.

tools.name: domains_dns
tools.description: Returns the DNS provider recorded for the domain, if known (e.g. Cloudflare, Namecheap): where its DNS records are configured. Custom domains only, and only while the domain is unverified; once its DNS is right there is nothing left to locate.

domain.description: Domain name (e.g. "www.example.com"). Must be a domain previously created with domains_set.

tools.name: domains_share
tools.description: Returns a shareable DNS setup URL that needs no API key, for whoever manages the domain's DNS. Custom domains only, and only while the domain is unverified; a verified domain has no setup left to share.

domain.description: Domain name to generate a share link for. Must be a domain previously created with domains_set.

tools.name: domains_validate
tools.description: Check if a domain name is valid and available before creating it. Returns the normalized form and availability.

domain.description: Domain name to check (e.g. "yourname.shipstatic.com" or "www.example.com"). Call before domains_set to check availability.

tools.name: domains_verify
tools.description: Trigger DNS verification for a custom domain. Call after the user has configured DNS records from domains_records. Custom domains only, and refused once the domain is verified: read domains_get instead. Verification is asynchronous: read the domain again with domains_get to learn the verdict, since its `status` has not moved yet when this returns. A verified domain serves nothing until a deployment is linked with domains_set.

domain.description: Domain name to verify DNS for. Must be a domain previously created with domains_set.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Returns your email and name, and the account's plan, usage and caps.
